safety.title: Safety & Assistance Center
safety.subtitle: Empowering citizens with rapid emergency tools, safe journey monitoring, and direct incident reporting.

safety.safeJourneyDesc: Continuously monitor your transit trip, send automatic check-ins to trusted contacts, and receive alerts if the bus deviates.

rights.disclaimer: Information is provided for public awareness and should not be treated as formal legal counsel. Refer to official government statutes for full texts.
